channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound: Fiscal risks cloud outlook – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that recent optimism around United Kingdom (UK) Prime Minister Burnham faded quickly, with British Pound (GBP) gains versus Euro fully reversed.

item.title: Equities: Chip rebound offsets rates repricing – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid notes that despite higher United States (US) Treasury yields and renewed speculation about a July Fed rate hike, US equities advanced, led by a strong recovery in chip stocks.

item.title: Euro gathers strength against British Pound after UK June CPI inflation falls by more than expected
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross gains momentum to near 0.8525 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the Euro (EUR) following the UK inflation report. All eyes will be on the European Central Bank (ECB) interest rate decision later on Thursday.

item.title: United Kingdom CPI inflation eases to 2.6% YoY in June vs. 2.7% forecast
item.description: The United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 2.6% over the year in June, compared to a rise of 2.8% in May, the data released by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Wednesday.

item.title: Gold: Safe-haven demand offsets energy risks – ING
item.description: ING’s commodities team notes Gold and Silver have extended gains on dip-buying and geopolitical concerns in the Middle East. They highlight Gold trading above $4,000/oz and Silver near $60/oz, supported by safe-haven flows and stronger industrial metals sentiment.

item.title: British Pound remains depressed against US Dollar following soft UK inflation data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) consolidates losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, as a string of UK inflation figures provided some leeway for the Bank of England to maintain its “wait-and-see” stance through the coming months.

item.title: British Pound attracts bids against Japanese Yen after mixed UK CPI data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) witnesses slight buying interest against its major currency peers after the release of the United Kingdom (UK) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for June. Against the Japanese Yen (JPY), the British currency rebounds strongly from the intraday low of 218.20.

item.title: Gold stands firm near two-week high as USD bulls remain on sidelines amid US-Iran hopes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone heading into the European session and currently trades just below a two-week high, set earlier this Wednesday.

item.title: Euro: Mild downside within defined range against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note EUR/USD under mild downward pressure after slipping toward 1.14, but expects any intraday decline to be limited to a test of 1.1380, with major support at 1.1360 unlikely to be challenged.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Likely to extend rally towards 164.00
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) hovers near a multi-decade high at around 163.24 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Wednesday. The USD/JPY pair reflects significant strength as the Japanese currency underperforms due to surging Oil prices.

item.title: Indian Rupee resumes decline as oil prices rise further
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a slight relief the previous day. The USD/INR pair rises to near 96.45 as a fresh surge in oil prices due to intensifying fears of further global energy supply disruptions has weakened the Indian currency.

item.title: Euro gains ground above 1.1400 on hawkish ECB tone
item.description: The EUR/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.1410 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday, bolstered by a hawkish tone from the European Central Bank (ECB).

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah inches lower ahead of BI policy decision
item.description: USD/IDR inches higher after six days of gains, trading around 17,960 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) struggles ahead of Bank Indonesia’s (BI) upcoming policy decision due later in the day.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as risk aversion support US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF continues its winning streak for the third successive day, trading around 0.8130 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) receives support from growing risk aversion tied to escalating geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Consolidates near 0.7000 as bulls await 38.2% Fibo. breakout
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick and extends its sideways consolidative price move around the 0.7000 psychological mark on Wednesday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Rises to near $85.00 on supply disruption, but remains capped below 100-day SMA
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $84.90 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The WTI rises as rising tensions in the Middle East raise fears of further disruptions to global oil supplies and international trade.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: British Pound bounces off one-week low vs USD amid Iran diplomacy hopes, ahead of UK CPI
item.description: The GBP/USD pair edges higher during the Asian session on Wednesday, snapping a four-day losing streak to the 1.3360 area, or a one-week low, touched the previous day.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests ascending triangle top above 186.00
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 186.20 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross is retaining a bullish near-term bias as it holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $60.00 despite surging inflation fears
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the fourth successive day, trading around $59.70 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Silver prices are surging despite rising rate-hike expectations, as powerful market forces outweigh the drag of higher interest rates.

item.title: US Secretary of State Rubio: Iranian control of Hormuz would have repercussions beyond Middle East
item.description: In Wednesday’s Asian session, the US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Southeast Asian foreign ministers that Iranian control of the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage to almost 20% of global energy supply, would set a dangerous precedent with repercussions beyond the Middle East.

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens to near 101.00 despite mounting Middle East tensions
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.15 in the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The DXY declines amid US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate uncertainty.

item.title: US President Donald Trump approves US-Saudi Arabia nuclear deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump approved a landmark agreement with Saudi Arabia that could potentially provide the kingdom with uranium enrichment capability for its civilian nuclear program, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis threaten Bab el-Mandeb closure, putting another trade chokepoint at risk
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis said that they have closed the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to Saudi-linked shipping in retaliation for the kingdom’s blockade on Yemen and a recent attack on the international airport in Yemen’s rebel-held capital, Sanaa, the Guardian reported on Wednesday.

item.title: US CENTCOM says it has completed 11th night of strikes on Iran
item.description: The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) said that it completed another night of attacks that targeted “military operations centers, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities, and military logistics infrastructure to further degrade Iran’s ability to threaten commercial sh

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges higher amid bullish oil prices; upside potential seems limited
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on its strong weekly gains registered over the past two days and edges lower during the Asian session on Wednesday. Spot prices currently trade around the 1.4100 round figure, though the fundamental backdrop warrants caution for aggressive bearish traders.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
item.description: NZD/USD depreciates after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory and trading around 0.5830 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens above 0.7000 on RBA hawkish stance
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.7010 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) as the likelihood of the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) interest rate hike rises.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says will take necessary steps on forex as required
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Wednesday that the authorities will take necessary steps on the foreign exchange if necessary.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7933 vs. 6.7917 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7933 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7917 and 6.7737 Reuters estimate.
